description: The February 14 CNL anniversary is described as a public celebration, and reports of injuries concern people attending it, but no turnout or protest demand is documented. The exclusion follows the reported celebratory purpose and absence of an identified protest demand, not a verified attendance count.
required_followup: If reconsidered, seek an independent contemporaneous account distinguishing any separate protest from the anniversary celebration and documenting its demand and simultaneous attendance.

description: Discovery included two Kirundi-language query formulations and French/English searches, but there was no fluent Kirundi review, systematic local-language newspaper archive search or audio review. Local and provincial coverage remains uneven.
required_followup: Use fluent Kirundi review and accessible provincial media/audio archives; keep claims about occurrence and attendance unresolved until direct evidence is read.

description: The exact RPA February 11 bulletin URL returned HTTP 404 after earlier technical failures; no body was available. The IWACU march-title lead returned cache misses and local DNS failure with no HTTP response, so date and content remain unknown. IWACU’s saved /2021/02/ path rendered current 2026 material, not a February archive. A CrisisWatch lead uses a staging hostname whose publisher/origin was not established; no body was requested.
required_followup: Revisit only the same documented public URLs when access permits and after fresh exact-URL review; do not infer missing content from technical failures or the unrelated current archive page.

description: Several captured leads remain search-only: the 2021 State Department report and ecoi record, RPA’s CNL abduction story, the Presidency archive, the Ministry youth-dialogue article, the June 2021 Burundi HRI report and the January ACAT landing/report record. Search metadata alone supplies no event evidence.
required_followup: Review these original sources if a later coordinator pass finds them material; retain their search-only status and do not infer dates, gatherings or response facts from snippets.

description: No prior-start or continuing February event was established. The January ACAT record remains unopened, while the March 4 RPA bulletin is a mixed-source compilation with no dated February protest and inconsistent future-dated material. This is insufficient to claim complete coverage of actions crossing either boundary.
required_followup: Use contemporary January–March reporting to establish any specific start, continuation or physical end; do not treat publication dates, month-end or an undated grievance as event boundaries.

description: The first pass recorded 16 public-web queries and 326 ordered result headers, including four English weekly windows, but open-web discovery does not reproduce LexisNexis or paid print/audio archives. It supports a bounded first pass, not an exhaustive inventory or a zero-protest claim.
required_followup: Use authorized systematic newspaper/archive coverage and locally informed searches in a separate review; preserve this open-web scope and do not infer absence from result scarcity.

description: The Burundi Forum CNL anniversary page reproduces the AGNEWS report. ACAT and FORSC describe related CNL assaults but provide no independent attendance count or demand. RPA bulletins attribute individual items to other outlets, while the underlying items were not independently reviewed; FORSC underlying informants remain unidentified.
required_followup: Trace each underlying report before treating repeated text or compilation items as independent confirmation.

description: The official current Mass Mobilization baseline, licensing, schema and reviewer determination remain outside this worker’s evidence. No candidate was integrated or assigned an official MM identifier; the baseline gate remains pending.
required_followup: Coordinator verifies the official baseline, codebook and conditions before any consolidation or official coding.
